```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6
)
```

```{r load config and validate, include=FALSE}
# ---- Load configuration --------------------------------------------------
cfg <- jsonlite::read_json(params$params_file, simplifyVector = TRUE)
# shared helpers of cytoflowgui: log_msg, with_log, note, is_text, ...
source(file.path(cfg$helpers_dir, "helpers.R"), local = TRUE)
log_msg("Configuration loaded")
# ---- Validate configuration ----------------------------------------------
log_msg("Validating configuration...")
stopifnot(
  "fb_name must be a non-empty string" = is_text(cfg$fb_name),
  "fcs_dir must be a non-empty string" = is_text(cfg$fcs_dir),
  "data_dir must be given by cytoflowgui" = is_text(cfg$data_dir),
  "cytometer must be one of: flow, spectral, mass, none" =
    isTRUE(cfg$cytometer %in% c("flow", "spectral", "mass", "none")),
  "language must be a non-empty string" = is_text(cfg$language),
  "test_mode must be TRUE or FALSE" = is_flag(cfg$test_mode)
)
log_msg("Configuration validated successfully")
```

## Processing

```{r load_packages}
log_msg("Loading required packages...")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(cytoElements)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(knitr)
  library(lubridate)
})
```

```{r scan_fcs}
# ---- Scan FCS files -------------------------------------------------------
fcs_dir <- normalizePath(cfg$fcs_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
fcs_files <- list_fcs_files(fcs_dir)

# the flowBunch is created in the data folder of the step
fb_dir <- cfg$data_dir
dir.create(fb_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
fb_dir <- normalizePath(fb_dir, mustWork = FALSE)
```

```{r init_flowbunch}
# ---- Initialize flowBunch object -----------------------------------------
log_msg("Creating flowBunch object: %s", cfg$fb_name)

# Prepare parameters for fb_initiate
init_params <- list(
  project_name = cfg$fb_name,
  project_dir = fb_dir,
  fcs_dir = fcs_dir,
  cytometer = cfg$cytometer
)

# optional cofactor (the default of the cytometer is used when empty)
if (!is.null(cfg$cofactor) && !identical(cfg$cofactor, "")) {
  init_params$cofactor <- cfg$cofactor
}

# Create flowBunch object
fb <- with_log(do.call(fb_initiate, init_params))

if (is.null(fb)) {
  stop("fb_initiate returned NULL, see the console for details.")
}

fb <- with_log(fb_update_pheno_dates(fb, lang = cfg$language))

if (is.null(fb)) {
  stop("fb_initiate returned NULL, see the console for details.")
}

log_msg("flowBunch object created successfully")
log_msg("Pheno rows: %d, Panel rows: %d", nrow(fb@pheno), nrow(fb@panel))
```

```{r save_flowbunch}
# ---- Save flowBunch object -----------------------------------------------
# done before the plots: an error in a plot cannot lose the flowBunch
if (!cfg$test_mode) {
  log_msg("Writing flowBunch to disk...")
  with_log(fb_write(fb))
  log_msg("Saved to: %s", fb_file_path(fb))
} else {
  log_msg("Test mode, not writing to disk")
  log_msg("flowBunch file path would be: %s", fb_file_path(fb))
}
write_session_info(cfg)
```

## Summary

```{r ignore errors from now, echo=FALSE}
# ---- From here on, only the report is left -----------------------------------
# The flowBunch is saved, so an error in a report chunk must not fail the step:
# it is kept in the report, written to the GUI console, and the next chunks run.
# Earlier chunks (validation, scan, init, save) still stop the render on error.
report_only_from_here()
```

```{r summary, echo=FALSE, class.source='fold-show bg-warning'}
info <- step_info(
  cfg, "fcs_dir",
  c(
    "flowBunch name" = cfg$fb_name, "Cytometer" = cfg$cytometer,
    "FCS files" = length(fcs_files), "Pheno rows" = nrow(fb@pheno),
    "Panel rows" = nrow(fb@panel),
    "Test mode" = ifelse(cfg$test_mode, "Yes", "No"),
    "File path" = fb_file_path(fb)
  )
)
knitr::kable(info)
```

```{r notes, results='asis'}
if ("acq_date" %in% colnames(fb@pheno)) {
  timeline_df <- data.frame(
    File = basename(row.names(fb@pheno)),
    Date = as.Date(fb@pheno$acq_date),
    Cells = fb@pheno$TOT
  )
  if (any(is.na(timeline_df$Date))) {
    note("Some files lack valid acquisition dates")
  }
} else {
  note("The pheno table lacks the 'acq_date' column")
  timeline_df <- NULL
}
print_notes()
```

## Output

```{r output, results='asis'}
if (cfg$test_mode) {
  cat("- test mode: the flowBunch was not written\n")
} else {
  cat(paste0("- `", fb_file_path(fb), "`\n"), sep = "")
}
```


## Plots

### Cell counts per file

```{r cell_counts}
counts_df <- data.frame(
  File = basename(fb@pheno$sample_id),
  Cells = fb@pheno$TOT
)

ggplot(counts_df, aes(x = reorder(File, -Cells), y = Cells)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2E9ECE", alpha = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Cell Counts Per File",
    x = "File",
    y = "Total Cell Count (TOT)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)
  )
```

### Acquisition timeline: cell counts

```{r timeline check}
if (is.null(timeline_df)) {
  skip_timeline <- TRUE
} else {
  timeline_df <- timeline_df[!is.na(timeline_df$Date), ]
  skip_timeline <- nrow(timeline_df) == 0
}

if (skip_timeline) {
  log_msg("Timeline plots skipped due to missing or invalid dates")
}
```

```{r timeline cell counts}
if (!skip_timeline) {
  ggplot(timeline_df, aes(x = Date, y = Cells)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8, color = "#2E9ECE") +
    coord_flip() +
    geom_line(aes(group = Date), color = "grey60", alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(
      title = "Acquisition Timeline",
      x = "Acquisition Date",
      y = "Total Cell Count (TOT)"
    ) +
    scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%Y-%m-%d") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
    guides(color = "none")

}
```

### Acquisition timeline: file counts

```{r timeline file counts}
if (!skip_timeline) {
  ggplot(timeline_df, aes(x = as.Date(Date))) +
    geom_bar(fill = "#2E9ECE", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = after_stat(count)), stat = "count",
      hjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "Acquisition Timeline",
      x = "Acquisition Date",
      y = "Number of FCS files"
    ) +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y-%m-%d") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
}
```
